title: Twelve Note Fugue

source_midi.note: Composer's file, unchanged. 3 instrument tracks, no percussion.

arranged_midi.note: Source tracks byte-identical + track 5 'Percussion' on channel 10. Regenerate with render/export_midi.py.

files.audio: Not stored in git. Rendered MP3/FLAC were delivered in chat; regenerate with render/ (see render/README_remix.md).

score.tempo: bar 1: quarter=120; from bar 2: quarter=225 (dotted quarter=150)
score.bar_numbering: bar 1 starts at tick 0, bar 2 at 6144, bar 3 at 9216, then 6144 ticks per bar; 'slot' = eighth note 0-11 within a bar

channel_1.render: Fracto Legacy 'GrandB piano' recordings (instruments/originals/GrandB_*.mp3 + indexes/grandb-*.json); layer and gain rule as in sdk/music/MidiPianoSamples.js

channel_2.render: Modelled tonewheel organ with rotary speaker (render/organ.py), drawbars 858865435, 2nd-harmonic percussion. Not a Fracto sample; user likes this sound.

channel_3.render: FluidR3 'Acoustic Bass' from FluidR3_GM.sf2, per-sample tuning correction (samples measure up to ~16 cents flat)

channel_10.velocity_note: Velocities encode the intended stroke strength (vel = 127*v^0.8 for drums, 127*v^0.7 for hats). In the audio mix the hi-hat bus sits about 4-6 dB below the bongo/timbale buses; a player with one gain law for all percussion will play the hats relatively louder.

percussion_design.opening: No percussion before bar 3 and nothing on the bar-3 downbeat. The two opening notes and the silence after them must stay untouched; only the start of the riff answers them. Hi-hat fades in during bar 3, bongos enter at bar 5 and ease in.
percussion_design.bongos: Background part. Accents follow the syncopation: off-beat band hits in 'stab' bars (slots 1, 3, 7), peaks of the running line otherwise; the stroke after an accent is left out. Beats 1 and 3 (slots 0, 6) only a light low-drum touch. Fingertip ghost strokes on the other eighths. Last beat of every even bar is a turnaround chosen from 7 figures, never the same twice running. When only one instrument is sounding, ghosts drop out and the rest plays at 0.4.
percussion_design.timbales: Sparse: section starts, fills at section ends, one stroke on beat 4 of odd bars in the loudest sections, final hit at bar 80 slot 8. Single hit at the bar-50 stop.
percussion_design.hi_hat: Double-time: closed hat on every eighth, soft. 56 split-second openings (under 0.1 s, then closed) at irregular spacing (7-24 eighths apart), never on beats 1 or 3.
percussion_design.break: Bars 51-52 (piano solo) have no percussion; timbale pickup at the end of bar 53.
percussion_design.room: Hand drums in a live room: 0.75 s decay, wet about 4.5 dB under dry.

removed.drum_kit: v1-v2 used a full kit (rock, then Purdie half-time shuffle / Peart-style). User preferred a background hand-percussion approach. Kept in render/drums.py.
removed.brush: v5 brush swirl hits and v6 continuous equal-circle stir were both rejected. Wanted: brush kept on the head in circular motion with LONG-SHORT strokes, not equal strokes. Not yet attempted. render/perc.py render_stir() is the rejected equal-circle version.

dynamics.note: Source velocities are nearly flat, so the build of the piece is shaped by section. Values are dB relative to the loudest sections; crescendo through the last bar before a louder section.
dynamics.applied_as: Piano velocity offset = 14 + 5*dB (so loud sections reach the mf layer); bass velocity offset = 4*dB; organ swell before its drive stage; half of the dB again on the whole mix. Not baked into the arranged MIDI.

balance.organ_vs_piano: Organ notes that double a piano note at the same moment (426 of 841) are played at 0.45 gain, and the organ dips up to ~4 dB whenever the piano sounds, so the piano carries doubled lines.

dialogue.idea: Where piano and organ trade the running melody against the syncopated figure, the one with the melody swells forward and the other settles back; hand-over on the three pick-up notes (slots 8.4-9.6 of the previous bar).
dialogue.rule: Per bar: an instrument 'leads' if it plays on 9 or more of the 12 eighths while the other plays on 1-7.

gain_db.half_strength: bars where the same instrument leads in both neighbouring bars

balance.master: -14 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -1 dBTP, loudness range about 6.5 LU

history.change: Modelled piano/organ/electric bass, rock drum kit.
GrandB piano and FluidR3 acoustic bass + Standard kit from Fracto; drums rewritten toward Steely Dan / Rush feel.
Organ pulled back behind piano; kit replaced by background bongos/timbales. Also a no-drums version.
Bongos follow the syncopation, light on beats 1 and 3, varied turnarounds, back off under solos, more room.
Brush snare + hi-hat player added; bongos down ~3.5 dB and softened.
Continuous brush stir; double-time hi-hat with brief openings; no percussion before the piece begins.

open_ideas: Brush snare: on-the-head circular stir with long-short motion.
Bake section dynamics and dialogue swells into the MIDI (velocities / CC11) so the All Music player reproduces them.
Check how the All Music engine balances channel-10 notes against the melodic channels; adjust percussion velocities if the hats are too loud there.
No-drums variant: re-render from v8 if wanted (last no-drums render was v3).
